{{Quote|Try to appreciate the scenery, Kamus. Most people never get to visit a place like this.''"<br />"''This is a horrible place. No wonder Czerka built their base in the Dune Sea--no one would ever want to look for it here.|Agent Fauler and former Czerka employee Kamus Orden at the SIS forward outpost|<ref name="LOO" />}}
A '''forward outpost''' was operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
{{Quote|I'll feel a lot better when we change bases, Fauler. I don't like this.''"<br />"''You say that now, but just wait until you see the real desert.|Kamus Orden and Fauler prepare to relocate to the SIS forward outpost|<ref name="TA">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Timely Arrival|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>}}
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643BBY" /> the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]], the primary [[Spy/Legends|intelligence]] agency of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]],<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Strategic Information Service}}</ref> operated a forward outpost at the [[Outpost Salara]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], SIS [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Fauler]], former [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] employee [[Kamus Orden]], and other SIS personnel and Republic heroes utilized the building during their investigation into a Czerka research project concerning a dangerous [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="LOO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The SIS Forward Outpost appeared as a story area for all four Republic player character classes on Tatooine in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]].<ref name="LOO" />
